$comment: Config for the product-parity tools. Place at repo root (or scripts/parity/) and run: node <skill>/scripts/parity-gate.mjs

routes.$note: File-router discovery. Next.js: filename 'page.tsx', dir 'app'. For anything else use "list": ["/", "/settings", ...].

i18n.$note: Optional. Omit the whole block to skip i18n checks.

review.$artifacts: Product-specific suppression rules. The skill inlines artifacts caused by the CAPTURE TECHNIQUE (test-runner fonts, undecoded images); anything caused by YOUR product's stubs or features belongs here, because the skill cannot know what you stubbed. Omit the list on a new harness — you learn it from the board — and the reviewer will say so on every run. Every field below is REQUIRED and validated before any capture is reviewed.

artifacts.element: the COUNT of item tiles in the catalog grid
artifacts.cause: catalog sync is stubbed offline in the capture harness
artifacts.counterClause: A catalog BUTTON or control present on one client and not the other, on any screen, IS a finding and must be reported.
artifacts.removeWhen: the capture harness serves real catalog sync

design.$comment: OPTIONAL — omit and check D skips cleanly. When present, the design system is upstream of BOTH clients and the check is symmetric: the source client fails the same way the mirror does. This is what stops a source-client bug becoming the specification.
design.$dirNote: Committed snapshot PULLED FROM the design tool. Read-only in the repo — edit upstream and re-pull, or the next pull reverts your edit. One snapshot, one path: a per-client copy drifts and nothing would catch it.

clients.name: mobile
clients.$note: dart compares names ONLY — values are converted (oklch->sRGB, rem->logical px), so value equality is meaningless

geometry.$comment: OPTIONAL — omit (or leave invariants empty) and check H is a silent no-op. SHARED CHROME ONLY: composer, page header, canvas header, list row. Keep under ~5 entries. Per-screen invariants rot and train people to ignore the check. Cross-client spread comparison — not absolute offsets. Regions are fractions of image width/height.

invariants.name: chat-composer-row
invariants.$note: Composer icons and placeholder must share a vertical centre on BOTH clients. Measure real captures before inventing boxes; do not add per-screen entries.
